subject: Design retainer & event staging — proposal + renewal options
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: StudioK Creative <hello@studiok.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Inquiry: retainer + event launch support (April)

Hi Evan / StudioK team,

We’re planning a product launch in early April and are exploring a 3–6 month design retainer + event creative support. High level: live launch event (hybrid), product website refresh, and a handful of campaign asset sets.

Can you send a short proposal with:
- Monthly retainer bands and hourly rates for ad-hoc work
- Typical deliverables by month for a 3-month engagement vs 6-month
- Any blackout dates/capacity issues in March–April
- A sample SOW and ratecard (PDF/XLS fine)

Budget is flexible but we’re aiming to keep retainer + event staging under $120k for the core scope.

Looping in Vanessa (events) and Laura (procurement) here so they can flag any must-haves on procurement or staging.

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
From: Evan Cole <evan@studiok.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: StudioK Creative <hello@studiok.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Inquiry: retainer + event launch support (April)

Hi Kim — thanks for reaching out and congrats on the launch.

Attached is a short proposal and our 2026 ratecard. Quick highlights:
- 3-month retainer (core design + campaign coordination): $55k/mo (includes 3 FTE design hours/week + PM)
- 6-month discounted retainer: $45k/mo (we can front-load event work)
- Day rate for on-site event creative lead: $1,200/day
- Event staging coordination (vendor management, stage design, AV oversight): estimated $28k–$40k depending on scale

We have capacity in late March for prep and the week of April 6–10 for onsite support.

Attachments: StudioK_Proposal_Retainer_Feb2026.pdf; StudioK_Ratecard_2026.xlsx

Happy to jump on a 30-min call this week to walk through.

Best,
Evan Cole
Co-founder, StudioK Creative
evancole@studiok.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Cole <evan@studiok.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: retainer + event launch support (April)

Thanks Evan — appreciative of the fast turnaround.

Laura — can procurement review the attached terms and confirm if StudioK’s standard SOW + T&Cs are ok? We’ll likely need a shorter cancellation window for on-site work and a clause for vendor-subcontractor background checks.

Vanessa — can you confirm whether the $28k–$40k estimate for staging aligns with our previous events (we had about $35k last time for AV + set + rigging)? Also flag any preferred staging vendors we want StudioK to coordinate with.

Evan — can you also confirm whether the retainer includes up to 2 rounds of stakeholder reviews per asset and how additional rounds are charged?

Thanks,
Kim
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: StudioK Creative <hello@studiok.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 10:01:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Inquiry: retainer + event launch support (April)

Hi Evan — procurement here. A few items we need clarified before legal can ingest the SOW:
1) Payment terms — we prefer net 30; StudioK’s proposal lists 45 days. Can you accommodate net 30 for retainer invoices?
2) Data handling — any design files or user materials you receive should be stored on a secure, access-controlled drive; please confirm your cloud provider and whether you have SOC 2 or equivalent controls.
3) Background checks — for on-site stage leads and rigging subcontractors, we require signed statements and basic background checks.
4) Insurance — proof of general liability and workers’ comp; minimum $1M GL.

If you can update the SOW to reflect net 30 and a short addendum on security/insurance, we can move to a DocuSign exchange this week.

Laura Bennett
Head of Procurement, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
From: Evan Cole <evan@studiok.com>
To: laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: StudioK Creative <hello@studiok.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Inquiry: retainer + event launch support (April)

Laura — thanks, that’s all reasonable. Quick responses:
- Net 30 OK.
- We host assets in Box and maintain role-based access; we do not currently have SOC 2 but can provide a third-party security questionnaire and our data handling SOPs.
- Background checks: yes, we’ll provide signed statements for on-site leads and confirm vetting for subcontractors.
- Insurance: we have $2M GL and will attach certificates.

I’ve attached a revised staging SOW (EventLab_Staging_SOW_v2.pdf) that reflects scope and a cancellation policy (60 days for full refund; 30–14 days partial; <14 days non-refundable on site costs).

Next steps: if the terms look good, I’ll send an updated proposal and a DocuSign envelope for the retainer.

Regards,
Evan
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Cole <evan@studiok.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: retainer + event launch support (April)

Thanks all — quick confirmations and next steps:
- Procurement (Laura): will review the updated SOW and insurance cert; Laura, please confirm by EOD Friday if we can proceed with DocuSign.
- Finance (Connor): can you confirm budget alignment? Current ask (3-month retainer + mid-range staging) sits at ~$140k which slightly exceeds the $120k target; we can tighten scope or move to 6-month retainer to lower monthly.
- Events (Vanessa): please confirm preferred vendor list and whether StudioK can engage the preferred AV partner (SoundBridge) — we’d prefer to keep a single staging vendor to control costs.

Evan — assuming procurement and finance sign off, please go ahead and send the DocuSign envelope and final invoice for the retainer. We’ll aim to finalize by next week so you can lock March prep dates.

Attachments referenced above will be placed in the GDrive folder linked here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AaBCD-staging-retainer

Thanks — Kim
